stability_envelope_summary: The artifact remains stable only when recursion neutrality, altitude containment, reflection boundedness, tensor integrity, and curvature purity are strictly maintained. Any violation destabilizes the triadic hybrid and risks recursion, elevation, or reflection drift.
non_activation_clause: This stability envelope is descriptive-only. It does not activate, simulate, or bind any NDH subsystem, geometry mechanism, holonomy operator, recursion engine, or altitude-routing process.
